description: vibe.d 0.10 on its own fiber based event loop, default configuration, one listener task per core sharing the port with SO_REUSEPORT. Routing through URLRouter, JSON through vibe.data.json, gzip through the built-in Accept-Encoding negotiation. json-tls on 8081 through vibe-stream:tls on OpenSSL, one listener per worker like the plaintext port.
